title: Link
description: x-link makes its host a checked link. An http(s) href opens in a new tab once it answers; a #id href scrolls smoothly to that element, offset pixels short of it. A target that does not exist, or a bare #, turns the link red (x-link--invalid) with the reason in its title.

href.description: Where the link goes: an http(s) URL or a #id on this page.

text.description: Link text. The text between the tags wins; this fills an empty host.

offset.description: Pixels to stop short of a #id target when scrolling, e.g. the height of a fixed header.

setup: Back to the top
